title: Execution policy: which harness, provider, model and effort run an invocation
description: Model routing is policy, not architecture (WC §18). Resolved once at dispatch and pinned on the invocation (ADR-0010). With configured=false no invocation receives a policy-selected execution and harness launch is refused; there is no built-in provider or model. Only environment variable NAMES appear here, never values.

containment.description: OS filesystem containment of harness runs (F2, Linux; ADR-0009 amendment). mode required (the default) refuses a launch whose sandbox cannot be established or fails its self-test; allow_weaker launches it labelled workdir_separation_only. writable adds existing directories every contained run may write (recorded on each run's label); a root that equals, contains or lies under what containment protects (the project's .aew, its git directories, the runs directory, /tmp, the Python environment, a masked secret) is refused at launch. hide masks further secret files or directories. trusted_git_drivers names the git filter, diff and merge drivers AEW's own git may run (an installed program agents cannot modify, such as git-lfs); every other configured driver, hook and fsmonitor is switched off, and a dispatch whose base assigns an untrusted filter is refused.

steering.description: Crawl/Walk/Run steering (crawl-walk-run steering design v0.1 §5, §6; M4-E plan v3 §2.1). mode is the project default; absent keeps legacy/manual behaviour and is not a fourth mode. Adopting a default that raises autonomy (rightward of the mode in force without a raise; absent to crawl is not a raise) changes nothing until the operator raises the mode at the operator endpoint (`aew lead mode raise`).

notify.description: The unattended-Run notifier (M4-E operator decision 1): an argv run supervisor-side, never through a shell, with a JSON event on stdin, a sanitized environment and bounded time and output. Raising the mode to run requires command[0] to resolve to an executable file. Delivery lands with the steering loop (M4-E E7).

recall.description: Register F21's Arm B prototype (the lead developer's plan v6). raw_history_search "off" (the default, also when absent; quote it, since YAML reads a bare off as a boolean, which is refused with its cause and fix) leaves `aew history search` unregistered and creates no search index; explicit registers it for an operator terminal or a Lead shell, never inside an invocation. Read only from the adopted bytes of this file: an edit counts once the operator adopts it. Operational: it changes no dispatch, gate, transition, pack or resume.

maps.description: Project maps in context (register F22.1, plan §5.1; ADR-0015). pack_slices "off" (the default; quote it, since YAML reads a bare off as a boolean) leaves every pack and the Lead's resume view byte-identical to a project without maps; structural adds the bounded structural-map section to the packs of roles whose context names codebase_map, and the map's row to the resume view. Turning it on is the operator's configuration decision.
